text:
jordan: quick design QA — on the inventory list when viewport is ~375px (iPhone SE) the grid collapses and the right-side action drawer overlaps the last column. looks like drawer z-index + compact row height are fighting. screenshot: https://img.redwood/test/ss-375.png
mei: saw this in staging too. repro: open item, collapse sidebar, rotate to portrait, tap search. chips and badges clip into the overflow menu.
sam: quick fix idea: reduce row min-height from 56px -> 48px at <=420px and force action drawer to full-width sheet on narrow screens. snippet: ```@media (max-width:420px){ .row{min-height:48px} .side-drawer{position:fixed;right:0;left:0} }```
alex: prefer full-screen sheet instead of a floating modal for discoverability — also improves hit targets for the drawer close btn.
maya: accessibility nits: when drawer becomes full-screen the focus trap needs to announce "Item actions dialog" to SR users and close button must be 44px touch target. ensure keyboard users can reach overflow with tab.
mei: copy tweak: change "More actions" -> "Actions" on small screens to avoid wrapping. consider hiding non-essential badges in compact mode (cost, tags) to reduce horizontal overflow.
jordan: can we add a 360px breakpoint to hide low-priority columns? collapse "tags" and "region" into a details flyout.
sam: plan: columns visible at >=768, reduced at 420-767, minimal at <420. i'll push a prototype.
design-bot: deploy preview: https://staging.redwood/preview/tx-388 — uses compact rows + sheet drawer for <420.
maya: UX test idea: simulate 1-thumb navigation — are close icons and primary actions reachable by thumb when holding phone bottom-left? if not, move primary action down.
jordan: good call. 3-person quick test tomorrow. sam add an a11y checklist in the PR?
sam: on it — will include: focus order, aria-labels for close, role=dialog + aria-modal, 44px touch targets, SR announcement strings.
mei: visual tweak: reduce sheet shadow to rgba(0,0,0,0.12) — current shadow reads heavy on OLED.
jordan: thanks all. plan: sam prototype + PR, maya accessibility review, quick 3-person test. aim to ship next sprint. :thumbsup:
